fitAnalysis.assessment:
You are a FAIR FIT at 68%: your FP&A core is solid, but the tooling and Board-level gaps need preparation.

**Strengths:**
- 5 years in budgeting, rolling forecasts and variance analysis
- Advanced Excel (INDEX/MATCH, pivot tables, VBA) plus Power BI dashboards on SAP data
- B.S. Finance and ACCA progress (9 of 13 papers)

**Gaps:**
- No Pigment, Tableau or Metabase experience (Pigment is a must-have)
- No ROI analysis or Board materials preparation shown
- No PowerPoint or consumption-based software model experience

**Recommendation:** Apply now, build a small Pigment or Tableau sample project first, and use your cover letter to link your order-backlog forecast rebuild to Datadog's consumption-driven forecasting.

coverLetter:
Tomas Brandt
Chicago, IL, USA
tomas.brandt@example.com
+1 555 0123

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Datadog

Dear Hiring Manager,

Budgets and forecasts only help leaders when they trust the numbers. At Calder Industrial Components, forecast accuracy for our larger business unit sat at 88%, so I rebuilt the model around order backlog and brought it to 96%. That is the problem your R&D Finance team solves for Engineering and Product leadership: turning financial data into decisions they can act on.

As a Financial Analyst, I own the monthly forecast and variance reporting for two business units with combined revenue of about 85 million USD. With 5 years of experience in budgeting, forecasting and month-end reporting, I'm used to sitting with operational leaders and explaining what the variances mean. I also shortened our month-end close reporting from 9 working days to 6 by automating journal checks in Excel VBA, and I build Power BI dashboards on SAP data for plant managers. Your ad mentions managing departmental budgets, financial forecasts and analytics, and consistency in tools, templates and processes across planning cycles. That is the work I do now. I haven't used Pigment, Tableau or Metabase, but I'm comfortable with BI tooling and I learn new systems quickly. I hold a B.S. in Finance and have passed 9 of 13 ACCA papers.

I'd welcome a conversation about how I could support your R&D Finance team and its partnership with technical leadership. I'm available to talk at your convenience.

Kind regards,
Tomas Brandt

applicationEmail.subject: Application: FP&A Analyst, Tomas Brandt
applicationEmail.body:
Dear Datadog Hiring Team,

You're looking for someone to manage forecasts and budgets with senior leaders, and that's the work I've done for 5 years, including rebuilding a forecast model around order backlog so it tracked the business more closely. I bring advanced Excel and a finance degree, and I build Power BI dashboards that turn messy data into clear numbers for decision makers. My CV and cover letter are attached for you to look through. I'm available for a call any weekday afternoon (Central Time) and can start a conversation about timing whenever suits you.

Best regards,
Tomas Brandt
